title: Vaporesso DOJO Blast Pod & Refill For 10K or 30K Device – Blue Razz Lemonade
description: Please Note: Compatible with Vaporesso Dojo Blast 10K & 30K Kit Only Refresh your Vaporesso Dojo Blast 10K vape kit with the Blue Razz Lemonade Prefilled Pod & Refill Pack. This vibrant refill pack includes a 2ml prefilled pod and an 8ml refill container, both filled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid in a sweet and citrusy flavour blend. Blue Razz Lemonade combines the tangy sweetness of Blue Raspberry with the bright bubbly zest of Lemonade for a fizzy, fruit-forward vape that’s both punchy and refreshing. It’s a great choice for vapers who enjoy sharp, flavourful profiles with a citrus edge. Each pod and refill pack is designed exclusively for the Dojo Blast 10K device and offers up to 10,000 puffs (device total), powered by Vaporesso's dual mesh coil and COREX 2.0 technology. The transparent pod design makes it easy to track your e-liquid levels, while the Smart Liq-Cycle system ensures steady coil saturation for consistently excellent flavour. Explore all 28 flavours from the Vaporesso Dojo Blast 10K collection here at Vapestore.
